account_credential_password_ck.name: account_credential_password_ck
account_credential_password_ck.value: provider_id <> 'credential' OR password IS NOT NULL

employments_dates_ck.name: employments_dates_ck
employments_dates_ck.value: start_month IS NULL OR end_month IS NULL OR start_month <= end_month

employments_current_ck.name: employments_current_ck
employments_current_ck.value: NOT is_current OR end_month IS NULL

profiles_urls_ck.name: profiles_urls_ck
profiles_urls_ck.value:
linkedin_url ~* '^https?://[^[:space:]]+$' AND char_length(linkedin_url) <= 300
        AND github_url ~* '^https?://[^[:space:]]+$' AND char_length(github_url) <= 300
        AND portfolio_url ~* '^https?://[^[:space:]]+$' AND char_length(portfolio_url) <= 300

resume_imports_shape_ck.name: resume_imports_shape_ck
resume_imports_shape_ck.value: (parse_status <> 'failed' OR parse_error IS NOT NULL) AND (parse_status <> 'parsed' OR parsed_at IS NOT NULL)

resume_revisions_name_ck.name: resume_revisions_name_ck
resume_revisions_name_ck.value: name IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

resumes_user_job_uq.name: resumes_user_job_uq
resumes_user_job_uq.where: "resumes"."kind" = 'tailored' and "resumes"."archived_at" is null and "resumes"."job_id" is not null

resumes_shape_ck.name: resumes_shape_ck
resumes_shape_ck.value: (kind = 'base' AND job_id IS NULL AND base_resume_id IS NULL AND application_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'tailored' AND NOT is_default)

resumes_version_ck.name: resumes_version_ck
resumes_version_ck.value: version >= 1 AND (base_version IS NULL OR base_version >= 1)

applications_approval_shape_ck.name: applications_approval_shape_ck
applications_approval_shape_ck.value:
(status IN ('approved','submitting','submitted','failed') AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND channel IS NOT NULL)
        OR (status = 'draft' AND approved_at IS NULL AND channel IS NULL) OR status IN ('withdrawn','refunded')

credit_ledger_sign_ck.name: credit_ledger_sign_ck
credit_ledger_sign_ck.value:
(reason IN ('plan_grant','free_grant','refund_failed_submit') AND delta > 0) OR (reason = 'submission' AND delta = -1)
        OR (reason = 'expiry' AND delta < 0) OR (reason = 'admin_adjustment' AND delta <> 0 AND note IS NOT NULL)

credit_ledger_shape_ck.name: credit_ledger_shape_ck
credit_ledger_shape_ck.value:
(reason IN ('plan_grant','expiry') AND stripe_invoice_id IS NOT NULL AND application_id IS NULL)
        OR (reason = 'free_grant' AND stripe_invoice_id IS NULL AND application_id IS NULL)
        OR (reason IN ('submission','refund_failed_submit') AND stripe_invoice_id IS NULL)
        OR (reason = 'admin_adjustment' AND stripe_invoice_id IS NULL)
